xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: To our letter dated 24th January, 2025 [wherein the Company had intimated regarding Office of Additional Commissioner of Commercial Tax (Enforcement-02) South Zone, VTK-2, Koramangala, Karnataka ("GST Authority"), has raised a demand of tax and interest amounting to Rs. 238.82 lakh on the Company].Further to our letter dated 24th January, 2025 the Company has informed an update on the matter that GST Authority, has imposed tax, interest and penalty amounting to Rs. 261.82 lakh for the financial year 2023-24 and 2024-25 on the Company, as per their Show Cause Notices dated February 18, 2025, issued under section 73(1) the Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, due to a mismatch of GSTR3B and GSTR7.The Company is in the process of replying against the Show Cause Notices.
